worldcombat.skill.uturn.summary: Dart in along a U-shaped arc, strike, then fold back along the curve; with a waiting reserve the strike swaps to it, the relay style withdraws to a waiting partner, the wide style pulls straight back. The strike itself is the escape.
worldcombat.skill.uturn.use.0: Hit and disengage, giving up your ground
worldcombat.skill.uturn.use.1: Fold back to open distance before being broken
worldcombat.skill.uturn.use.2: With someone to relay to, drag the foe toward your pack
worldcombat.skill.uturn.description.0: Darts in and strikes a living target for %1$s physical damage.
worldcombat.skill.uturn.description.1: Dash distance %1$s blocks, %2$s blocks per tick, hit radius %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.uturn.description.2: Folds back %1$s blocks with a U-arc width of %2$s blocks; the relay style withdraws to the nearest waiting partner within %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.uturn.handoff.on: Relay style: withdraw to the nearest waiting partner within the rally radius; return distance ×0.78.
worldcombat.skill.uturn.handoff.off: Stand-off style: pull straight back along the arc; return distance ×1.15, the furthest from the foe.
worldcombat.skill.uturn.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recover %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costs %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.uturn.growth.0: From level %1$s the flyby strike rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.uturn.growth.1: From level %1$s the flyby strike rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.uturn.preference.hando: On: withdraw to the nearest waiting partner within the rally radius, return distance ×0.78 — safer with someone covering you, but not as far from the foe. Off (stand-off): pull straight back along the arc, return distance ×1.15, the furthest away, but you leave your partners behind.
worldcombat.skill.uturn.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this distance it closes in first; a bit wider than the dash so it still starts the flyby, lower keeps the fold at point-blank.
worldcombat.skill.uturn.preference.ai.fl: Below this health ratio, the fold is ranked first as an escape; raise it to leave earlier, lower it to keep it for emergencies.
worldcombat.skill.uturn.preference.ai.le: When on, the user folds away even under a hold order; off keeps it only when convenient in place.
